bachelorPitch.title: Bachelor Thesis Collaboration (HEIG-VD)
bachelorPitch.subtitle: A 14-week dedicated engineering mandate realized in collaboration with an enterprise or institution, concluding the Media Engineering BSc at HEIG-VD.
bachelorPitch.heroDesc: The Travail de Bachelor (TB) is a 14-week capstone engineering project completed in direct partnership with an external company or organization. It immerses a final-year Media Engineering student in professional conditions to build concrete, production-ready digital solutions backed by academic supervision from HEIG-VD.

context.sectionTitle: How the Mandate Works with HEIG-VD
context.sectionSubtitle: Key modalities and commitments outlined by HEIG-VD for host companies.
context.durationDesc: Structured as a 4-week pre-study (problem analysis, state of the art, planning, risk evaluation) followed by 10 weeks of full-time engineering and delivery.
context.remunerationDesc: The mandate is an integral part of the academic degree; no salary is required. Companies may optionally provide an expense allowance for meals and transport.
context.confidentialityDesc: Projects can be held strictly confidential upon request (only title and abstract made public). Intellectual property agreements are arranged directly with the company.
context.autonomyDesc: The student works autonomously with agreed milestones. The host company designates a point of contact to provide feedback and validate deliverables.

tracks.sectionTitle: What I Bring to Your Organization
tracks.sectionSubtitle: Pragmatic engineering and design capabilities tailored to enterprise needs.
tracks.track1Problem: Legacy web interfaces, complex workflows, or slow rendering pipelines causing developer friction and user drop-off.
tracks.track1Solution: Building reactive, high-performance web applications with React, TypeScript, clean architecture, and modern build tooling. Backed by 9 years of programming discipline.
tracks.track1Deliverables: Production-ready frontend code, modular component architecture, and clean API integration.
tracks.track2Problem: Misalignment between design mockups and frontend code, resulting in inconsistent UI, poor ergonomics, and slow development cycles.
tracks.track2Solution: End-to-end interface design in Figma (wireframes, interactive prototypes, design systems) paired with pixel-perfect implementation in clean CSS/Tailwind.
tracks.track2Deliverables: Interactive Figma prototypes, structured design system tokens, and accessible, responsive UI components.
tracks.track3Problem: Dense operational data, financial metrics, or complex workflows that are difficult for users to inspect and interpret in real time.
tracks.track3Solution: Designing responsive dashboards and visualization interfaces that transform complex data feeds into clear, interactive charts and ergonomic control panels.
tracks.track3Deliverables: Custom charting modules, real-time data inspection interfaces, and intuitive analytical views.

timeline.phase1Desc: Initial discussions between the company and student to identify needs and define project scope.
timeline.phase2Desc: Official partnership agreement and academic approval of the mandate topic by HEIG-VD.
timeline.phase3Desc: Execution of the 14-week project with intermediate progress check-ins, concluding with the engineering report.
timeline.phase4Desc: Final presentation before an academic jury and an industry expert. Company representatives are invited to attend.

cryptoDetail.disclaimer: Closed Beta Notice: This platform was built as a proprietary system for an investment entity. To maintain institutional confidentiality and protect private API keys, the telemetry and data feeds demonstrated below are simulated frontend replicas of the production engine.
cryptoDetail.overviewSubtitle: High-throughput autonomous algorithmic trading terminal engineered for multi-pair surveillance, real-time orderbook telemetry, and automated LLM macro synthesis.
cryptoDetail.caseStudySubtitle: In-depth engineering breakdown of the quantitative indicators, real-time data streaming, AI sentiment ingestion, and multi-broker telemetry pipeline.

section1.title: 1. Multi-Pair Surveillance Pipeline & 24h Volume Scanner
section1.p1: The market scanning subsystem establishes a dual-tier surveillance pipeline. The primary tier continuously tracks an eleven-token blue-chip basket (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, ADA, DOGE, AVAX, SUI, TRX, and LINK) to maintain baseline market liquidity metrics. Concurrently, a secondary dynamic scanner queries the Binance 24-hour ticker endpoint, filtering over 300 trading pairs with stringent liquidity criteria: enforcing strict USDT pairing, requiring a minimum $10,000,000 quote volume threshold, and eliminating leveraged and stablecoin tokens to prevent non-volatile noise.
section1.p2: The dynamic scanner ranks candidates by absolute volatility and selects the top 5 momentum gainers to monitor real-time breakouts across market cycles.

section2.title: 2. Dual-Regime Execution Engine & Vector Allocations
section2.p1: The core strategy engine operates on an autonomous dual-regime framework governed by the 14-period Average Directional Index (ADX). When ADX exceeds 25.0, the engine activates the Smart Momentum module, identifying 20-candle Donchian channel breakouts corroborated by a 2.0x surge above the 20-period volume moving average. In low-trend regimes (ADX below 25.0), execution transitions into Dynamic Grid Mean Reversion, placing limit ladders within calibrated Bollinger Band envelopes.
section2.p2: Capital allocations adhere to fractional Kelly Criterion sizing capped at 2.0% maximum portfolio risk per vector. The paper trading state machine coordinates continuous trailing stop adjustments, dynamic profit-target lock-ins, and deterministic stop-loss executions with zero DOM latency.

section3.title: 3. Trading212 API Integration & Hybrid Telemetry
section3.p1: The platform's visualization layer employs a hybrid architecture designed to deliver sub-millisecond telemetry feedback alongside high-density multi-timeframe financial charts. Deep candlestick inspection is handled by embedding hardware-accelerated TradingView charts with custom toolbar and styling overrides, providing institutional indicators and interactive drawing tools.
section3.p2: For portfolio telemetry and equity performance, the frontend utilizes Recharts to render virtual balance history, equity curves, and asset allocation distributions without DOM frame stutter. Modular API adapters interface with Trading 212 API telemetry endpoints and Binance WebSocket streaming connections, ensuring price ticks and simulated fill events update reactively without memory leakage.

section4.title: 4. Automated AI Market Intelligence & Daily Strategist Brief
section4.p1: To eliminate emotional bias and manual disclosure analysis, the platform integrates an automated AI intelligence pipeline executed via scheduled background workers. The pipeline ingests top macroeconomic news headlines alongside CoinGecko global telemetry, including Bitcoin market dominance percentages, 24-hour global trading volume, and trending search velocity.
section4.p2: This consolidated dataset is formatted into a strict institutional context and processed through Groq's high-throughput LLaMA 3.3 70B Versatile model. The model is constrained via system prompts to return deterministic JSON schemas containing normalized numerical sentiment scores (-1.0 extreme bear to +1.0 extreme bull), concise single-sentence dashboard summaries, three key narrative metadata tags, and an institutional Bloomberg-style daily market digest dispatched directly to communication channels.

about.title: About
about.summary: I'm Steve Benjamin, 24, based in Bussigny, Switzerland, studying Media Engineering at HEIG-VD. I began coding nearly 9 years ago in embedded electronics, writing C for microcontrollers, drones, and Bluetooth audio, before shifting my focus to modern web front-end development and UX/UI design in Figma. Outside of pure tech, I spent over 4 years founding and leading a youth group, which built my foundation in team leadership and public speaking at conferences and work. When I'm away from the keyboard, you'll usually find me on the basketball court, analyzing chess games, or reading.
